audit.whatIsWrong: The page disagreed with itself: diff says EVEN while diffRating is 8/10 and both breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t call it a 'Hard matchup'. The data is 50.46% over 767 games.
audit.why: A 50.5% matchup is even, and a reader seeing 'EVEN' next to 8/10 gets no usable read. I moved the numeric ratings and the prose to match the diff token rather than the reverse, because the win rate supports EVEN.
audit.corrected: diffRating 8/10 -> 6.5/10, carryRating 8.5/10 -> 7.5/10, and both difficulty sentences now read 'Even matchup'. Chart rows left alone — they match the packet.

audit.why: All four spikes exist here (no inherited gap) and his front-loaded curve is correctly described: level 2 Shield Vault is his kill spike, level 6 adds Grand Starfall's 5500-range global, and he cools off with items.
audit.corrected: Spike placement kept; the cooldowns behind each spike now appear (W 13s, E 22s, R 180s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls Aegis Assault a 'block' that 'negates your all-in damage' with no qualifier. Riot's text is specific: he becomes invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT. It is also a channel and a very long 22s at rank 1.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the page gets it backwards. Told the shield negates damage, the player waits out 22 seconds; told it only guards the front, the player uses the one tool that beats it — Ashen Pursuit teleports to a location before dashing to the target, so you can put yourself behind him and keep hitting. The whole all-in is available instead of forbidden.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, mid, late, wants.you[1], wants.foe[2], report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now state the frontal-only invulnerability, the 22s, and Shield Vault's 600 range / 13s.
sources: enemyKit E text 'invulnerable to damage from the front', flags shield/untargetable/channel, 22/21/20/19/18

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flagged it exactly: zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, 0 sequencing cues.
audit.why: Shield Vault at 13s versus your flat 10s blink is the whole lane clock, and Aegis Assault's 22s is the longest punishable window either champion has.
audit.corrected: Concrete 'wait for X' lines added to dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and mid.

edits.before: Pantheon's Comet Spear (Q) poke and Shield Vault (W) stun-gap close the moment you step up, and his Aegis Assault (E) block negates your all-in damage; his early kill pressure is brutal on a squishy assassin.
edits.after: Pantheon's Comet Spear (Q, 575) pokes and Shield Vault (W, 600 range, 13s) stuns the moment you step up; Aegis Assault only blocks damage from his front, so blink past him and keep hitting his back instead.
